title: Fermi Momentum
description: Essential Criteria: The correct expression for the Fermi momentum k_F must be derived as k_F = (3 pi^2 rho)^{1/3}.

title: Total Energy
description: Essential Criteria: The total energy E_tot must be correctly expressed as E_tot = (hbar^2 (3 pi^2 N q)^{5/3})/(10 pi^2 m_e) V^{-2/3}.

title: Quantum Pressure
description: Essential Criteria: The expression for quantum pressure P must be derived correctly as P = (hbar^2/(15 pi^2 m_e)) (3 pi^2 rho)^{5/3}.

title: Key Reasoning
description: Important Criteria: The student must show clear reasoning in deriving the relationships between k_F, E_tot, and P using appropriate physical principles.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the derivations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect factors in the final expressions.
